height.estimand: Equal mean of root-conditional mobility means; only roots with >=20 retained pairs/bin; not equilibrium weights.
height.uncertainty_caution: Conditional block/run-resampling spread; not a calibrated confidence interval. Adaptive lineage and three-run alanine limits remain.

cover.scope: Full-data witnessed complex in a projected chart. Maximal simplices preserve all faces. Display: 2-skeleton of the face-poset nerve of the base complex 2-skeleton; higher base simplices remain in metadata. No configuration-space homotopy claim.
cover.node_height: Mobility field evaluated in the bin containing the witness centroid; null if unsupported. Not conditional intersection-specific mobility.
